international.title: Fiona the hippo under veterinary care after eating hat at Cincinnati zoo
international.summary: Knit hat caught in ceiling fan and flung into enclosure eaten by Fiona, who is being closely monitored by zoo staff The Cincinnati zoo says Fiona, its beloved hippo who became a global celebrity after her premature birth nearly a decade ago, is undergoing veterinary care after swallowing a knit hat that got into her enclosure. Zoo veterinarians and staff are monitoring Fiona and working to help her pass the hat, the zoo said in a statement Monday. Continue reading...
